faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) for the position of Post Doctoral Fellowship under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics & IT Phase II.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under GGSIPU Post Doctoral Fellowship Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Post Doctoral Fellowship position in this recruitment cycle for the academic year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled-in application form along with all required documents via the designated Google Form is 14 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD degree from a recognized University along with a proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications such as at least two SCI/SCIE/ESCI indexed papers as the first author.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Post Doctoral Fellowship position is 40 years as per the guidelines specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered for this fellowship?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Post Doctoral Fellowship will receive a consolidated monthly salary or stipend amounting to ₹1,08,393 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for GGSIPU Post Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to compile their application form and requisite documents into a single PDF and submit via the designated Google Form.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of candidates followed by a rigorous Presentation-cum-Interview session scheduled tentatively for 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for submitting the application form for the Post Doctoral Fellowship position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University website at www.ipu.ac.in to access detailed guidelines, annexures, and application links.
